historicalExclusions: tooling/migration/** (immutable stage-1 proof, no active command dependence after 2.5a)

parsers.svelte: eslint-plugin-svelte recommended parser with typescript-eslint.parser for scripts

environments.tests: Vitest imports; no global test functions assumed

notAdoptedGlobally: no-unused-vars: not part of the bounded initial contract
no-explicit-any: historical syntax debt tracked separately; no new occurrences allowed
suppressionPolicy: Remove ESLint directives; enabled rules admit no errors/warnings. Existing Svelte compiler annotations are tracked separately by syntax and may not increase.
formatting: Prettier with Svelte plugin; formatting isolated from functional edits; only generated/binary/identified immutable historical records excluded.
parserContract: Use default JS parser, typescript-eslint.parser for TS, and parser supplied by eslint-plugin-svelte base config for Svelte; no optional preset rules imported. Correctness rules remain the exact selected set.
environmentProofs: Node JS accepts process and rejects window
Worker JS accepts self and rejects window
Svelte 5 runes/TypeScript parse; debugger rejected in JS/TS/Svelte/worker
noInlineConfig means suppression cannot hide an error; all agreed source patterns discovered
